title: Yarn checksum mismatches ignored
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a Yarn setting that ignores a cached-archive checksum mismatch. A corrupted or substituted archive installs without any error, which removes the one check that would notice the substitution.
remediation: Use `throw` so a mismatch fails the install.
limitation: It matches a Yarn setting that ignores a cached-archive checksum mismatch in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
